title: Test Scope Imports
goal: Bring outer functions into scope inside a unit test module.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unit Tests

hints: Look at how nested modules access their parent module items.
Use super to step up one module level, and choose an assertion macro that compares two values.
explanation: `use super::*;` pulls items from the parent module into `tests`. Writing `use self::*;` looks inside `tests` itself and fails with compiler error `E0425` because `add_bonus` is defined outside `tests`. `assert_eq!` compares two values for equality, whereas `assert!` takes a single boolean expression and fails with `E0308` when given two arguments without a format string.
